aboutStory.title: Our Story — Born on Hikkaduwa Beach
aboutStory.subtitle: Passionate local surfers sharing the authentic spirit of Sri Lanka's southern coast.
content: Hikka Surf School is a local Hikkaduwa surf school founded by ocean lovers who grew up riding the legendary waves of Sri Lanka's southwest coast. Our focus is simple: helping travelers enjoy the ocean safely, learn the genuine art of surfing, and discover our hometown through authentic local experiences.

Whether it is your very first time standing up on a surfboard in gentle white-water, improving your cutback on green waves, or snorkeling alongside gentle giant sea turtles on the Hikkaduwa reef, we treat every guest like family.

We believe in honest, grounded hospitality. All gear, rash guards, and safety briefings are provided, and all tours outside our direct school are coordinated transparently with respected local community partners.
aboutStory.highlightQuote: We don't just teach surfing; we share our deep connection to the ocean and the friendly warmth of Sri Lankan beach culture.

faqs.question: Do I need previous surfing experience?
faqs.answer: Not at all! Over 80% of our guests are complete beginners. We start with clear beach instruction and guide you in calm, forgiving white-water waves.

faqs.question: Do you provide surfboards and rash guards?
faqs.answer: Yes! All necessary equipment including beginner soft-top boards, high-performance epoxy boards, leashes, and UV rash guards are provided free with your lesson.

faqs.question: Can children join the surf lessons?
faqs.answer: Yes, kids from 5 years and up love our lessons! We maintain extra-close physical supervision in shallow water to ensure 100% safety and enjoyment.

faqs.question: What is the best time of day for surf lessons?
faqs.answer: Early mornings (7:00 AM - 10:30 AM) and late afternoons (3:30 PM - 6:00 PM) usually offer the lightest winds and smoothest glassy ocean conditions.

activities.title: Snorkeling in Hikkaduwa Coral Reef
activities.tagline: Explore Vibrant Coral Gardens & Marine Life
activities.shortDescription: Discover Hikkaduwa National Marine Sanctuary. Clear waters, tropical fish, live corals, and gentle ocean currents with expert local snorkel guides.
activities.fullDescription: The Hikkaduwa Coral Reef is Sri Lanka's first marine national park, famous for its shallow lagoon shelter, colorful coral formations, angelfish, parrotfish, butterflyfish, and resident sea turtles. We provide sanitized masks, snorkels, fins, life jackets, and a local guide who knows where the clearest visibility and marine life gather.
activities.meetingPoint: Hikkaduwa Coral Reef Beach Entrance, Marine Sanctuary Road
activities.safetyInfo: We follow strict reef protection guidelines: never step on living corals, maintain safe distance from marine life, and swim only in designated safe zones.

packages.title: Guided Coral Reef Snorkeling
packages.subtitle: Discover Marine Life Safely
packages.description: Guided snorkeling tour inside the calm Hikkaduwa Coral Sanctuary with colorful tropical reef fish.

packages.title: Private Family Snorkeling
packages.subtitle: Personalized & Relaxed Pace
packages.description: Private experience for your family with dedicated guide assistance for children and non-swimmers.

faqs.question: Can I snorkel if I do not know how to swim?
faqs.answer: Yes! We provide certified floating life jackets and our guide stays right beside you with a safety float ring.

faqs.question: Is all snorkeling equipment provided?
faqs.answer: Yes, sanitized tempered glass masks, dry-top snorkels, fins, and life jackets in all sizes are included.

activities.title: Turtle Experiences & Snorkeling
activities.tagline: Meet Wild Giant Green Turtles in Their Natural Habitat
activities.shortDescription: Swim alongside friendly giant green sea turtles in Hikkaduwa's calm shallows. Ethical, non-intrusive wildlife encounters with local ocean guardians.
activities.fullDescription: Hikkaduwa is famous worldwide for the wild giant sea turtles that visit the shallow bay right in front of the beach every day. Observe these majestic creatures grazing on seaweed in crystal-clear water. We emphasize respectful, ethical wildlife interactions with zero feeding or disturbing.
activities.meetingPoint: Hikkaduwa Turtle Beach Point, Hikkaduwa Beach
activities.safetyInfo: We practice 100% ethical viewing: never touch, ride, or corner turtles, maintaining at least 2 meters distance at all times.

packages.title: Turtle Snorkeling & Beach Walk
packages.subtitle: Most Magical Experience
packages.description: Snorkel with wild sea turtles in the shallow lagoon with expert guidance on turtle behavior and conservation.

faqs.question: Are the sea turtles in Hikkaduwa wild?
faqs.answer: Yes, they are 100% wild and free. They visit the shallow reef bay naturally to feed on sea grass.

faqs.question: Are we allowed to touch the turtles?
faqs.answer: No. To protect their health and well-being, we strictly follow non-contact, ethical observation guidelines.

activities.tagline: Witness Blue Whales & Dolphins in the Wild
activities.shortDescription: Comfortable day trip from Hikkaduwa to Mirissa for seasonal Blue Whale and Spinner Dolphin watching aboard licensed passenger vessels.
activities.fullDescription: Sri Lanka's southern coast is one of the world's premier destinations to spot Blue Whales (the largest animal on Earth), Sperm Whales, and acrobatic pods of Spinner Dolphins. We arrange your early morning transfer from Hikkaduwa directly to Mirissa harbour with trusted, safety-inspected marine operators.

faqs.question: When is the best season for whale watching?
faqs.answer: The peak season is from November to April when sea conditions in the southern Indian Ocean are calmest and Blue Whales migrate close to shore.

reviews.text: Best surf school in Hikkaduwa by far! My partner and I were complete beginners and honestly a bit nervous about the ocean waves. The instructors were so patient, encouraging, and made us feel 100% safe. We both stood up on our very first wave! Unforgettable experience.

Swimming with the giant wild sea turtles in Hikkaduwa was a dream come true. Our local guide was fantastic — he showed us the clearest spots and made sure we respected the animals. Also booked a surf lesson the next day through WhatsApp in seconds. 10/10 service!

As an intermediate surfer trying to progress from whitewash to unbroken green waves, the video debrief and lineup positioning coaching were gold. Friendly local vibe, top quality boards, and zero BS. Don't look anywhere else in Hikkaduwa.

We visited Hikkaduwa with our two kids (ages 8 and 11). The guys at Hikka Surf School were brilliant with the children. Super safe, huge smiles all round! They also organized an airport pickup and Galle Fort tour for us with a great driver.
Excellent instructor! Very technical explanation on body balance, foot placement and wave timing. Fast communication over WhatsApp. Highly recommend to anyone coming to Sri Lanka.

faqs.question: Do I need previous surfing experience?
faqs.answer: No previous experience is needed! Our beginner lessons are specifically designed for first-timers of all fitness levels. We begin with a safe beach theory briefing before guiding you into easy, waist-deep white water waves.

faqs.question: Do you provide surfboards and rash guards?
faqs.answer: Yes! All beginner soft-top boards, high-performance epoxy boards, leashes, and UV protective rash guards are included free of charge with all lesson packages.

faqs.question: Can children join surf lessons?
faqs.answer: Yes! Children from 5 years and older can safely join our kids surf lessons. Our instructors provide 1-on-1 supervision in shallow water to ensure complete comfort, safety, and confidence.

faqs.question: Can I book a private 1-on-1 lesson?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer dedicated private lessons with your own coach for maximum personal attention, accelerated learning, and tailored wave analysis.

faqs.question: How do I book an activity or surf lesson?
faqs.answer: Booking is quick and simple via WhatsApp! Just click any 'Book Now' button on our website to send us your date, group size, and preferred time. We will confirm your slot instantly with no complicated advance paperwork.

faqs.question: Can you arrange snorkeling, turtle experiences, and boat tours?
faqs.answer: Yes! We organize snorkeling at Hikkaduwa Coral Reef, wild turtle encounters, glass bottom boat trips, fishing tours, and river safaris daily.

faqs.question: Can you arrange Sri Lanka day trips and airport transfers?
faqs.answer: Yes! We arrange reliable private AC transport with friendly English-speaking drivers for Galle Fort, Bentota, Yala Safari, Ella, Kandy, and 24/7 Colombo Airport (CMB) pickups.

faqs.question: Where is Hikka Surf School located?
faqs.answer: We are located right on Narigama Beach, Galle Road, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka — directly opposite Hotel Citrus and right on the beach where the best beginner and intermediate waves break.
